property_summary: In the reference contract, forward() succeeds and does not revert when the external call succeeds; in the buggy version, forward() always reverts regardless of the external call outcome.
For any forward call, if the external callee reverts, the transaction must also revert; the buggy version violates this by completing successfully when the callee reverts.
For any callee and data, a call to forward() should succeed (not revert) when the external callee's call succeeds; the mutant incorrectly reverts on successful external calls.
